title: CPSC, Halcyon Manufacturing Announce Recall of SCUBA BC Inflators
summary: The SCUBA BC bladder can have a slow leak because of imperfections within the machining of the stainless air barrel of their inflators. This can cause unexpected buoyancy problems with divers, possibly resulting in decompression sickness. Units: About 4,000.

title: CPSC, IBM Announce Recall of AC Adapters for Notebook Computers
summary: The adapters can overheat, cause damage to the circuit board and melt through the housing, which poses a fire and electrical shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 225,000.

title: CPSC, Pelagic Pressure Systems Announce Recall of SCUBA BC Inflators
summary: Inflator buttons can stick, which can cause uncontrolled inflation of the BC. This could cause divers to ascend too fast, resulting in decompression sickness as well as the danger of an embolism. Units: About 11,600.

title: CPSC, Target Announce Recall of Electric Scooters
summary: Improper wiring can cause a short circuit, posing a fire hazard in the scooter. In addition, inadequate insulation may expose electrical wiring, which poses a shock hazard. Units: 74,811.

title: CPSC, Boston Billows Inc. Announce Recall of Nursing Pillows
summary: If infants are placed on these pillows and left unattended, there is a risk of suffocation. Infant pillows and cushions are banned under the Federal law. Infant pillows have a flexible fabric covering, are loosely filled with plastic beads, easily flattened, intended for use by infants under 1 year

title: CPSC, Regal Lager Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Stroller Attachments
summary: The Buggy Board's red connecting pins can break, causing the board to partially detach from the stroller or carriage, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 11,500.

title: CPSC, Theraline Inc. Announce Recall of Maternity and Nursing Pillows
summary: If infants are placed on these pillows and left unattended, there is a risk of suffocation. Infant pillows and cushions are banned under the Federal law. Infant pillows have a flexible fabric covering, are loosely filled with plastic beads, easily flattened, intended for use by infants under 1 year

title: CPSC, IMI Cornelius Announce Recall to Repair Frozen Carbonate Drink Dispensers
summary: The motor drive can overheat and cause the liquid contents to become hot. If this happens, the dispenser's nozzle can break and expose consumers to the hot liquid, posing a risk of burns. Units: About 990.

title: CPSC, Arctic Cat Inc. Announce Recall of Certain 2004 Snowmobiles
summary: The red plastic skis used on certain 2004 Firecat and Sabercat snowmobiles could crack or break as a result of off-season exposure to ultraviolet sunlight. Ski failure could lead to loss of control, that could result in severe injury or death. Units: 5,193.

title: CPSC, NCR Corp. Announce Recall of NCR Universal Inkjet Refill Kits
summary: The product does not have required child-resistant packaging or required warning labels. The product contains ethylene glycol, posing an ingestion hazard to young children. Units: About 78,000.

title: CPSC, Baby Swede, LLC Announce Recall to Repair "Baby Björn" Infant Carriers
summary: The back support buckle can detach from the shoulder straps, posing a fall hazard to the baby. Units: About 49,000.

title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: The front brake lines can crack and leak brake fluid, possibly resulting in loss of braking capability. This could result in severe injury or death. Units: 18,500.

title: CPSC, Hasbro Inc. Announce Recall of Monster Rockets
summary: The cap on the water tank can unexpectedly and forcibly project off when it is quickly unscrewed from the tank, posing a risk of impact injuries to users or bystanders. In addition, the rocket's tail can strike a user or bystander on descent, if the rocket is not fully launched, posing a risk of inj

title: CPSC, Suzuki Announce Recall of Four-Wheel Drive Eiger ATVs
summary: Mislocated welds securing the upper front suspension arm mounting brackets to the frame. The mounting bracket could break off during riding, reducing rider control and resulting in loss of control of the ATV. Loss of control could result in a crash and severe personal injury or death. Units: About 2

title: CPSC, Lexmark International Inc. Announce Recall of Laser Printers
summary: These printers can short-circuit, posing an electrical shock hazard to consumers. Units: 39,431.

title: CPSC, Goodman Company, L.P. Announce Recall of Amana, Trane, and American Standard Brand Package Terminal Air Conditioners/Heat Pumps
summary: Fire hazard, resulting from this chain of events: filter becomes clogged due to lack of maintenance, severely restricting airflow and resulting in elevated internal temperature; this may cause two safety switches to stop working during the product's expected life; if the blower wheel then stops when

title: CPSC, Full Speed Ahead Announce Recall of Scatto Bicycle Wheel Quick Releases Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
summary: An internal part in the lever mechanism can break, reducing clamping effectiveness and rendering the unit inoperable, potentially causing a bicyclist to fall. Units: About 1,375 sets.

title: CPSC, Specialized Bicycle Components Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
summary: The handlebar may loosen and turn unexpectedly, which can cause the rider to lose control and fall. Units: About 1,500.

title: CPSC, PlayKids USA Announce Recall of Baby Walkers Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
summary: The walkers will fit through a standard doorway and are not designed to stop at the edge of a step. Babies using these walkers can be seriously injured or killed if they fall down stairs. Units: About 1,600.

title: CPSC, Sauder Woodworking Co. Announce Recall of TV/VCR Carts Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
summary: The carts can tip over and the television can fall off, posing a risk of serious injury or death if the TV and cart fall on a child. Units: 300,000.

title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: The throttle cable may bind when the handlebars are turned full left or full right, resulting in an increase in engine speed and unintended vehicle acceleration. In addition, the fuel line may rub against the vehicle chassis, resulting in a fuel line leak, which could be a fire hazard. Units: About

title: CPSC, IKEA Home Furnishings Announce Recall of Glass-Door Wall Cabinets Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
summary: Some of these glass-door wall cabinets have the wrong sized screws for the safety bracket, which can result in the cabinet not being properly secured to the wall. The cabinets can fall and injure nearby consumers. Units: About 25,000.

title: CPSC, Natura Products Downey Inc. Announce Recall of Pacifiers Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
summary: The pacifiers are banned under federal law. They failed federal safety tests, come apart, and can pose a choking hazard to infants and small children. Units: About 9,400.

title: CPSC, Delta Enterprise Corp. Announce Recall to Repair Director's Chairs for Children Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
summary: The chair can inadvertently be misassembled, so that the fabric seat can come off the chair's frame and expose metal support rods. If fabric seat comes off the frame, there is a laceration and fall hazard to young children. Units: About 81,000.

title: CPSC, Bombardier Recreational Products Inc., and Deere & Company Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: Front brake hose can be pulled out of its retaining brackets on either side of the ATV by foreign objects. This can cause the brake hose to wear by rubbing on the inner wheel or shock absorber spring seat, ultimately causing a brake fluid leak, resulting in a complete loss of front braking capacity.

title: CPSC, Eddie Bauer Announce Recall of Ebtek Brand Backpacks with Stools
summary: The stool could collapse and cause the person using the stool to fall. The stool does not meet the firm's strength requirements. Units: About 300 units.

title: CPSC, Performance Inc. and Supergo Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Handlebars
summary: The handlebars can develop cracks that may not be visible, which can cause the handlebar to break without warning, resulting in serious injury or death. Units: About 300.

title: CPSC, Gruga U.S.A. Announce Recall to Repair Office Chairs Sold At Staples Stores
summary: The legs on the base of the chair can break, posing a risk of injury to the user. Units: 18,000.

title: CPSC, Wild Country Ltd. Announce Recall of Helium Carabiners
summary: The carabiner gate may come open under a heavy load, which will significantly reduce the strength of the carabiner. The carabiner could break if the climber falls, posing a risk of serious injury or death to the climber. Units: About 1,000.

title: CPSC, Reebok International Announce Recall of Toddler's Athletic Shoes
summary: The I-3 logo-tag on the tongue of the shoe can be peeled off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 140,000.
